item.title: 'Tippy Toes' baby food puree recalled over potential health risks to children
item.description: "Tippy Toes" branded Apple Pear Banana Fruit puree, made by Initiative Foods, is being recalled due to elevated levels of patulin.

item.title: Tiempo: New York City Council passes reform bill to help street vendors obtain license to work
item.description: New York City Council members recently passed a bill which makes it easier for vendors to obtain a license. Former Mayor Eric Adams vetoed the reform package before he left office.

item.title: Here and Now: Mount Sinai, Real Dads Network partner to improve heart health of Black men
item.description: As we mark American Heart Health Month, we're taking a closer look at health disparities in the Black community. Today, we're putting a spotlight on often undiagnosed heart conditions in Black men.

item.title: Tyler Reddick wins NASCAR Daytona 500 for Michael Jordan-owned 23XI Racing
item.description: Tyler Reddick won the Daytona 500 in a car owned by Michael Jordan when Chase Elliott crashed as he and Reddick were battling for the win.
